files.description: Parcel deliveries (240 rows): delivery_id (whole number), city (city name; capital letters and spaces are inconsistent), status (exactly "shipped" or "pending", always lower case, no empty cells), parcels (whole number; about 2% empty), express (True or False; about 5% empty).

task_text: Tidy the city names (remove surrounding spaces and write each word with a capital first letter, as in 'Oslo'). Encode status as 1 for shipped and 0 for pending in a column shipped. For each city, give the share of deliveries that were shipped and the average number of parcels. `result` should be a table indexed by city with the columns shipped and parcels.
intended_computation: Per tidied city (6 cities), the mean of the 1/0 shipped indicator over all its deliveries and the mean of parcels over its non-empty parcels cells.

acceptable_variants.notes: shares may be given as 0-1 values to 6 significant digits.

predicted_direction.reason: replace() downcast the 1/0 column to integers on 2.x, so mean(numeric_only=True) kept it; on 3.x it stays a generic column and is dropped, so the shipped share is missing.

notes: Drafted 2026-11-11 by pkg:TASKS_M2 for catalogue row N01; naive.py shows the invited idiom, reference.py is the version-robust reference.
